planeTypeStep.gimbalSubtitle: Your board is configured as a multirotor. You can set up gimbal servos for camera control.
planeTypeStep.gimbalTip: Gimbal uses RC stick input to control pan/tilt servos for camera stabilization.
planeTypeStep.subtitle: Select your aircraft type for the correct servo setup.
planeTypeStep.tip: Quad with camera? Select Gimbal. Plane? Most are Traditional.
planeTypeStep.title: What type of aircraft do you have?

servoAssignmentStep.clickToHighlight: Click a control surface to highlight it
servoAssignmentStep.duplicateWarning: Warning: Multiple surfaces assigned to the same servo!
servoAssignmentStep.subtitle: Match each control surface to the servo output it's connected to on your flight controller.
servoAssignmentStep.tip: Tip: Check your FC wiring. Servo outputs are usually labeled S1-S8 or SERVO1-8. S1 = Servo 0 in iNav.
servoAssignmentStep.title: Assign Servos to Control Surfaces

servoEndpointsStep.rateHint: Reduces travel range. 100% = full travel, 50% = half travel.
servoEndpointsStep.subtitle: Set how far each servo can move. If your servo makes a grinding noise at full stick, reduce the limits here.
servoEndpointsStep.tipGrinding: Grinding noise? Reduce the Min or Max value
servoEndpointsStep.tipNotLevel: Not level at center stick? Adjust the Center value
servoEndpointsStep.title: Fine-Tune Servo Travel

delta.description: Delta wing with elevons and rudder
delta.name: Delta
delta.tip: Like flying wing but with a vertical tail for rudder.

flyingWing.name: Flying Wing
flyingWing.tip: Elevons combine aileron and elevator function. No tail surfaces.

gimbal.name: Gimbal
gimbal.tip: For camera stabilization. Uses RC input, not stabilized output.

traditional.description: Standard plane with ailerons, elevator, rudder
traditional.name: Traditional
traditional.tip: Most common setup for planes. Separate control surfaces for each axis.

tricopter.name: Tricopter
tricopter.tip: Only the rear yaw servo needs configuration. Motors are handled separately.

vtail.name: V-Tail
vtail.tip: V-tail surfaces combine elevator and rudder. Standard ailerons.

aileronLeft.description: Rolls the plane left when down
aileronLeft.name: Left Aileron

aileronRight.description: Rolls the plane right when down
aileronRight.name: Right Aileron

elevator.description: Pitches the nose up when trailing edge goes up
elevator.name: Elevator

elevonLeft.description: Flying wing - combines roll and pitch
elevonLeft.name: Left Elevon

elevonRight.description: Flying wing - combines roll and pitch
elevonRight.name: Right Elevon

yawServo.description: Tricopter tail servo for yaw control
yawServo.name: Yaw Servo

servoReviewStep.noteConnected: Ensure your flight controller is connected
servoReviewStep.noteEeprom: Settings are stored in EEPROM (persist after power off)
servoReviewStep.noteTest: After saving, test all controls before flight
servoReviewStep.savedHint: Settings have been written to the flight controller. You can now close this wizard.
servoReviewStep.subtitle: Verify your servo configuration before saving to the flight controller.
servoReviewStep.title: Review Your Configuration

servoTestStep.checkAilerons: Ailerons: Roll stick right → right aileron should go UP, left should go DOWN
servoTestStep.checkElevator: Elevator: Pull stick back → trailing edge should go UP
servoTestStep.checkElevons: Elevons: Test both roll and pitch movements
servoTestStep.checkRudder: Rudder: Yaw stick right → rudder should move RIGHT

instruction.aileronLeft: Move roll stick RIGHT → this servo should move DOWN
instruction.aileronRight: Move roll stick RIGHT → this servo should move UP
instruction.elevator: Pull pitch stick BACK → trailing edge should go UP
instruction.elevonLeft: Roll RIGHT → DOWN. Pitch BACK → UP (trailing edge)
instruction.elevonRight: Roll RIGHT → UP. Pitch BACK → UP (trailing edge)
instruction.gimbalPan: Move yaw stick → camera should rotate horizontally
instruction.gimbalTilt: Move pitch stick → camera should tilt up/down
instruction.rudder: Move yaw stick RIGHT → rudder should deflect RIGHT
instruction.vtailLeft: Pitch BACK and Yaw RIGHT → test both movements
instruction.vtailRight: Pitch BACK and Yaw RIGHT → test both movements
instruction.yawServo: Move yaw stick → motor should tilt

servoTestStep.reverseHint: If a servo moves the wrong way, click Reverse.
servoTestStep.subtitle: Move your transmitter sticks and verify each servo responds correctly.
servoTestStep.title: Test Your Servos
